text:
Oh WOW! Look look LOOK!!! There’s a MAN in a BIG WOODEN TUB!!! Like, a HUGE tub!! And he’s all wet and smiling like he’s having the BEST DAY EVER!!! He’s got a towel on his legs — it’s white and fluffy like a cloud!! And he’s holding something yellow… is it a LEMON?? Or maybe a tiny ball?? I think it’s a lemon because lemons are fun to squeeze!!

And guess what?? His feet are sticking out!! One foot is RIGHT THERE by the edge of the tub!! So silly!! He looks so happy!! Like he’s at a spa or a magic bath from a fairy tale!!

There’s also a person in a RED ROBE standing behind him!! Are they a wizard?? Or a king?? Maybe they’re waiting for their turn in the tub too!!

The ground is made of stones and there’s sunlight everywhere!! It’s warm and bright and perfect for bathing outside!!

I wanna jump in with him!! Can we? Pleeeease?? We can bring rubber ducks and bubbles and sing songs!! This is the COOLEST THING I’VE EVER SEEN!!! 🦆✨
